title: pluck
pitch: Select text in any app, press a hotkey, and send it to your own scripts or an AI agent from a small menu at the cursor.
description: Actions are entries in one TOML file: a command that reads the text on stdin, or a prompt for an agent. Output streams into a panel, lands on the clipboard or replaces the selection. Agent sessions run on Pi, Claude Code or Codex.

externals.name: Selected text in other apps
externals.note: The browser demo opens the menu on a sample quote instead of text you selected elsewhere.

externals.name: Your action scripts
externals.note: Scripts don't run in the browser; their output is canned.

externals.name: Agent sessions
externals.note: Agent replies are canned; nothing is sent to a model.
